content.text:
I have thoroughly explored the repository. Here is my complete report.

## Build System & Running Tests

- Build system: Maven (`/home/daniel/sandbox/pom.xml`, artifactId `spring-petclinic-rest`; Maven wrapper `/home/daniel/sandbox/mvnw`). No Gradle files present.
- This is a Spring PetClinic REST app with an OfficeFloor arm; business rules live as small function classes under `.../rest/function/owner/`.
- Run all tests: `./mvnw test` (from `/home/daniel/sandbox`). Build: `./mvnw clean install` (readme.md line 218 shows `mvn clean install`; line 137 `mvn spring-boot:run`).
- Tests use JUnit 5 + `spring-boot-starter-test` / `-webmvc-test` / `-security-test` (pom.xml lines 140-150). The acceptance tests are `@SpringBootTest` + `@AutoConfigureMockMvc` + `@Transactional`.

## Central identity-computing class and its test

The single class that computes the identity code is `AssignCustomerCode` (region-and-hash + collision handling), with its helpers `CustomerCodeRegion`, `CustomerCodeCheckDigit` (Luhn), `AssignMembershipNumber` + `FiscalYear`, and the shared `Sha256Hex`. The full contents of all of these are reproduced below in the numbered sections. The governing test is `AcceptanceTest.java` (full contents in section 4/central-test below), backed by `AcceptanceBase.java` which reimplements SHA-256 HASH8 and Luhn to assert exact values.

Note: `AcceptanceTest` is a target-state (currently-failing) test. It asserts a unified `memberId` field of shape `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>` and that `customerCode`/`membershipNumber` are removed — none of which the production code produces yet (it still emits `customerCode`, `membershipNumber`, and a separate `checkDigit`).

---

### 1, 2, 3. Every file mentioning `customerCode`, `membershipNumber`, `checkDigit`

- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`
  - `customerCode`: field decl line 72-73 (`@Column(name="customer_code")`), getter/setter lines 191-197.
  - `membershipNumber`: field decl line 75-76 (`@Column(name="membership_number")`), getter/setter lines 199-205.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/.../rest/function/owner/AssignCustomerCode.java` — sets `customerCode` (line 30), reads others' codes for dedup (lines 40-41). Javadoc lines 14-25.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/.../rest/function/owner/CustomerCodeCheckDigit.java` — `checkDigit` class (line 11); reads `owner.getCustomerCode()` line 18-19.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/.../rest/function/owner/CustomerCodeRegion.java` — reads `owner.getCustomerCode()` line 20; class line 13.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/.../rest/function/owner/AssignMembershipNumber.java` — sets `membershipNumber` from `customerCode` (line 16). Javadoc line 7.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/.../rest/function/owner/AuditOwnerCreated.java` — logs `customerCode` + `membershipNumber` (lines 35-37); structured event carries `customerCode` (lines 58-61); `primaryIdentifier` returns `customerCode` (line 50).
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/.../rest/function/owner/OwnerSegment.java` — uses `CustomerCodeRegion.of` (line 27).
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/.../rest/function/owner/LocalityTimezone.java` — uses `CustomerCodeRegion.of` (lines 9, 26).
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/.../mapper/OwnerMapper.java` — imports `CustomerCodeCheckDigit`, `CustomerCodeRegion` (lines 9-10, 26); maps `locality` = `CustomerCodeRegion.of(owner)` (line 37-38) and `checkDigit` = `CustomerCodeCheckDigit.of(owner)` (lines 45-46).
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/.../acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java` — asserts `customerCode`/`membershipNumber` are removed (line 19); doc line 7.

`checkDigit` specifically appears only in: `CustomerCodeCheckDigit.java` (lines 11, 13) and `OwnerMapper.java` (lines 45-46).

### 4. `memberId` — does it already exist?

Not in production code. It exists only in the target-state test `AcceptanceTest.java`:
- line 7 (doc: "customerCode and membershipNumber are unified into 'memberId'"), line 13 (`coreReturnsUnifiedMemberId`), lines 16-18 (`r.get("memberId")`).
- Forward-looking reference in `AuditOwnerCreated.java` lines 45-47: comment says when `customerCode` is "later unified into the `memberId`", `primaryIdentifier` is the single switch point. The `OwnerDto` is OpenAPI-generated (no source file under `src/`), and currently exposes `checkDigit`/`identityKey`/`locality` rather than `memberId`.

### 5. Region-and-hash identity (SHA-256 over normalizedTelephone + lastName, first 8 hex "HASH8", region code)

Primary: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/.../rest/function/owner/AssignCustomerCode.java`
- Format `<REGION>-<HASH8>` built at line 29.
- `hash8()` lines 56-76: `MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")` over `(normalizedTelephone + lastName)` UTF-8 bytes (lines 65-66); takes first 4 bytes → 8 upper-case hex chars via `%02X` (lines 67-71). Telephone normalized via `E164Telephone.toE164OrNull` (line 59).
- REGION comes from `CustomerCodeRegion.of(owner)` → `LocalityLookup.regionOf(city, postcode)`.

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/.../rest/function/owner/CustomerCodeRegion.java` — extracts REGION prefix from existing code or derives from postcode/city (lines 19-28).

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/.../rest/function/owner/Sha256Hex.java` — shared full 64-char lower-case hex SHA-256 primitive (lines 19-32). Used by `OwnerIdentityKey` and `HouseholdId` (which take a prefix + upper-case).

Related but distinct identity hashes:
- `OwnerIdentityKey.java` — 64-char SHA-256 over `normalizedTelephone + '|' + lowerEmail + '|' + soundex(lastName)` (lines 37-43); the duplicate-check key.
- `HouseholdId.java` — first 12 upper-case hex of SHA-256 over `normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode` (lines 42-44).

Region lookup source: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/.../mapper/LocalityLookup.java` (`regionOf(city)` line 30, `regionOf(city, postcode)` lines 42-44, `regionOfPostcode` line 48).

Test replication of HASH8: `AcceptanceBase.java` `sha256hex` (lines 282-294) and `shaHex(s, n)` returning first-n upper-case (lines 297-299); `AcceptanceTest.java` line 15 computes `shaHex(telephone + lastName, 8)`.

### 6. Luhn check digit computation

- Production: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/.../rest/function/owner/CustomerCodeCheckDigit.java`, method `luhn(String)` lines 23-42 (iterates right-to-left, doubling alternate digits starting with `dbl=true`, skips non-digits, returns `(10 - sum%10) % 10`). Entry point `of(Owner)` lines 17-20.
- Test copy: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/.../acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java` `luhn(String)` lines 302-321 (identical algorithm).

### 7. Fiscal year (FY) computation

- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/.../rest/function/owner/FiscalYear.java` — 1 July basis. `endingYear(LocalDate)` lines 19-21 (`month >= JULY ? year+1 : year`); `label` returns `FY<YY>` lines 25-30; `elapsedBetween` lines 34-36.
- Consumers: `AssignMembershipNumber.java` line 15 (`FiscalYear.endingYear(...) % 100` → `-M<YY>`); `OwnerMapper.java` line 51-52 maps `fiscalYear` = `FiscalYear.label(...)`.
- Test side: `AcceptanceBase.toBusinessDay` (lines 268-274) and HOLIDAYS (lines 240-242) feed the registration date the FY is derived from.

### 8. Audit record

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/.../rest/function/owner/AuditOwnerCreated.java` (full contents shown above):
- Human-readable audit line with `customerCode`, `registrationDate`, `membershipLevel`, `membershipNumber` (lines 35-37).
- Structured immutable `OwnerCreatedEvent` record `{seq, ownerId, customerCode, membershipLevel, event:'OWNER_CREATED'}` (lines 58-63), emitted as JSON (line 41), monotonic `SEQ` (line 32, 39).

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR).
            When supplied it is prepended, after a single space, to the lastName to compose
            the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the owner's structured postal address (street number and
            name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied; normalized the same way (trimmed,
            whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: An optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (unit, suite,
            etc.). When supplied it is normalized and appended, after a single space, to the composed
            'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility, but the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are preferred
            when present. Returned as the normalized composed address — the normalized addressLine1,
            with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form
            (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). On create a national number is accepted and
            normalized (assuming country code '+61' when none is given).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+[0-9]{8,15}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postal code of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            four digits and, for a city with a known region, fall within that region's range
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. When omitted on creation it defaults
            to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional. When supplied it determines the
            owner's ageBand, computed against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the
            same last name and postcode (they are the same household); it bypasses the household
            duplicate block and creates the owner as a declared household member, which is never
            flagged as a possible duplicate. The householdId is deterministic and shared regardless
            of this flag. Write-only; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path to this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'.
                Derived at read time from the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's title and lastName, space-separated (e.g. 'DR who'),
                or just the lastName when no title is supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans — the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). Derived
                at read time; the raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the
                region derived from the owner's postcode and HASH8 is the first eight upper-cased hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated with lastName.
                Assigned at creation; there is no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the decimal digits contained
                in the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 6
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A deterministic identifier for the owner's household — the first 12 hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and postcode. Every owner has one,
                so owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's identity — the 64-character lower-case hex SHA-256 over
                'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)', where the email segment is empty when
                absent. Duplicate detection is keyed on this value, so creating an owner whose identity
                key matches an existing non-deleted owner is rejected with 409 unless 'sharesHousehold'
                is set.
              type: string
              example: 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created,
                already shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the fiscal year (1 July basis) of the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate, assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M27'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted
                'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year runs 1 July to 30 June and is labelled by the last two
                digits of the calendar year in which it ends (a date on or after 1 July belongs to
                the fiscal year ending the following calendar year).
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, assigned at creation. Starts at 0, and gains
                2 when an email is present, 1 when namesakeCount is 0, 2 for a household of 3 or more,
                and 3 for a tenure of more than one elapsed fiscal year (1 July basis).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, derived at creation from membershipPoints
                as 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5) and 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region taken from the owner's region-and-hash identity — the
                REGION prefix of the customerCode, derived from the owner's postcode (falling back to a
                fixed city-to-region table, Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD).
                'UNKNOWN' when neither the postcode nor the city maps to a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name for the owner's locality, taken from a fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the locality maps to no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The preferred contact channel for the owner, derived at read time.
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived at read time from birthDate measured
                against registrationDate. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>' — one of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO'
                when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when, at the moment this owner was created, more than 80 owners had
                already been created for the same business day; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when, at the moment this owner was created, the owner's city already
                held between 40 and 49 owners (inclusive) — approaching the per-city capacity limit
                of 50; otherwise false. The hard rejection at 50 owners per city is unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when, at the moment this owner was created, an existing owner
                shared this owner's last name and postcode but had a different telephone; the
                owner is still created (it is not a household duplicate). Always false for an owner
                created as a declared household member ('sharesHousehold' true). False otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate of,
                set only when 'possibleDuplicate' is true. Absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false.
                DELETE /api/owners/{id} sets this true and retains the record, so the owner is still
                returned by GET; a soft-deleted owner is ignored by the create endpoint's
                duplicate/identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR).
            When supplied it is prepended, after a single space, to the lastName to compose
            the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the owner's structured postal address (street number and
            name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied; normalized the same way (trimmed,
            whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: An optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (unit, suite,
            etc.). When supplied it is normalized and appended, after a single space, to the composed
            'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility, but the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are preferred
            when present. Returned as the normalized composed address — the normalized addressLine1,
            with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form
            (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). On create a national number is accepted and
            normalized (assuming country code '+61' when none is given).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+[0-9]{8,15}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postal code of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            four digits and, for a city with a known region, fall within that region's range
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. When omitted on creation it defaults
            to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional. When supplied it determines the
            owner's ageBand, computed against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the
            same last name and postcode (they are the same household); it bypasses the household
            duplicate block and creates the owner as a declared household member, which is never
            flagged as a possible duplicate. The householdId is deterministic and shared regardless
            of this flag. Write-only; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path to this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'.
                Derived at read time from the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's title and lastName, space-separated (e.g. 'DR who'),
                or just the lastName when no title is supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans — the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). Derived
                at read time; the raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: The owner's unified member identifier, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'
                where REGION is the region derived from the owner's postcode, FY is the two-digit fiscal
                year (1 July basis) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, HASH8 is the first
                eight upper-cased hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized (E.164) telephone
                concatenated with lastName, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the
                decimal digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Assigned at creation; there is no sequence
                number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D6'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A deterministic identifier for the owner's household — the first 12 hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and postcode. Every owner has one,
                so owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's identity — the 64-character lower-case hex SHA-256 over
                'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)', where the email segment is empty when
                absent. Duplicate detection is keyed on this value, so creating an owner whose identity
                key matches an existing non-deleted owner is rejected with 409 unless 'sharesHousehold'
                is set.
              type: string
              example: 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created,
                already shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the fiscal year (1 July basis) of the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate, assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M27'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted
                'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year runs 1 July to 30 June and is labelled by the last two
                digits of the calendar year in which it ends (a date on or after 1 July belongs to
                the fiscal year ending the following calendar year).
              type: string

              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, assigned at creation. Starts at 0, and gains
                2 when an email is present, 1 when namesakeCount is 0, 2 for a household of 3 or more,
                and 3 for a tenure of more than one elapsed fiscal year (1 July basis).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, derived at creation from membershipPoints
                as 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5) and 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region taken from the owner's region-and-hash identity — the
                REGION prefix of the customerCode, derived from the owner's postcode (falling back to a
                fixed city-to-region table, Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD).
                'UNKNOWN' when neither the postcode nor the city maps to a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name for the owner's locality, taken from a fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the locality maps to no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The preferred contact channel for the owner, derived at read time.
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived at read time from birthDate measured
                against registrationDate. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>' — one of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO'
                when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:

                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:

                already been created for the same business day; otherwise false.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR).
            When supplied it is prepended, after a single space, to the lastName to compose
            the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the owner's structured postal address (street number and
            name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied; normalized the same way (trimmed,
            whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: An optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (unit, suite,
            etc.). When supplied it is normalized and appended, after a single space, to the composed
            'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility, but the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are preferred
            when present. Returned as the normalized composed address — the normalized addressLine1,
            with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form
            (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). On create a national number is accepted and
            normalized (assuming country code '+61' when none is given).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+[0-9]{8,15}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postal code of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            four digits and, for a city with a known region, fall within that region's range
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. When omitted on creation it defaults
            to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional. When supplied it determines the
            owner's ageBand, computed against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the
            same last name and postcode (they are the same household); it bypasses the household
            duplicate block and creates the owner as a declared household member, which is never
            flagged as a possible duplicate. The householdId is deterministic and shared regardless
            of this flag. Write-only; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path to this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'.
                Derived at read time from the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's title and lastName, space-separated (e.g. 'DR who'),
                or just the lastName when no title is supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans — the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). Derived
                at read time; the raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: The owner's unified member identifier, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'
                where REGION is the region derived from the owner's postcode, FY is the two-digit fiscal
                year (1 July basis) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, HASH8 is the first
                eight upper-cased hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized (E.164) telephone
                concatenated with lastName, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the
                decimal digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Assigned at creation; there is no sequence
                number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D6'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A deterministic identifier for the owner's household — the first 12 hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and postcode. Every owner has one,
                so owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's identity — the 64-character lower-case hex SHA-256 over
                'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)', where the email segment is empty when
                absent. Duplicate detection is keyed on this value, so creating an owner whose identity
                key matches an existing non-deleted owner is rejected with 409 unless 'sharesHousehold'
                is set.
              type: string
              example: 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created,
                already shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted
                'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year runs 1 July to 30 June and is labelled by the last two
                digits of the calendar year in which it ends (a date on or after 1 July belongs to
                the fiscal year ending the following calendar year).
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, assigned at creation. Starts at 0, and gains
                2 when an email is present, 1 when namesakeCount is 0, 2 for a household of 3 or more,
                and 3 for a tenure of more than one elapsed fiscal year (1 July basis).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, derived at creation from membershipPoints
                as 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5) and 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region taken from the owner's region-and-hash identity — the
                REGION prefix of the customerCode, derived from the owner's postcode (falling back to a
                fixed city-to-region table, Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD).
                'UNKNOWN' when neither the postcode nor the city maps to a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name for the owner's locality, taken from a fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the locality maps to no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The preferred contact channel for the owner, derived at read time.
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived at read time from birthDate measured
                against registrationDate. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>' — one of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO'
                when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when, at the moment this owner was created, more than 80 owners had
                already been created for the same business day; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when, at the moment this owner was created, the owner's city already
                held between 40 and 49 owners (inclusive) — approaching the per-city capacity limit
                of 50; otherwise false. The hard rejection at 50 owners per city is unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when, at the moment this owner was created, an existing owner
                shared this owner's last name and postcode but had a different telephone; the
                owner is still created (it is not a household duplicate). Always false for an owner
                created as a declared household member ('sharesHousehold' true). False otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate of,
                set only when 'possibleDuplicate' is true. Absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false.
                DELETE /api/owners/{id} sets this true and retains the record, so the owner is still
                returned by GET; a soft-deleted owner is ignored by the create endpoint's
                duplicate/identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:

      type: object

        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.

        totalPages:

        size:

          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements

          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.

    PetFields:

    VetFields:
